free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed RNG seed so the positive/negative paths and bin sampling are deterministic across repeats and replay

free_parameters.name: positive_op
free_parameters.why: real repository op class whose name is absent from PARAM_CONFIG1, so param_config.get(..., None) returns None

free_parameters.name: negative_op
free_parameters.why: real repository op class present in PARAM_CONFIG1, so the derived config is not None

free_parameters.name: in_shape
free_parameters.why: a valid NCHW float32 input tensor shape; input_shapes is unused on the config-is-None path and only feeds the already-negated config path

execution.entry_reason: The official entry random_model_gen constructs a PureSymbolGen and GuidedGen is never instantiated anywhere in the repository, so random_model_gen cannot reach this Region. The driver therefore instantiates the real GuidedGen class and calls its real extra_constraints method directly with real AbsOpBase nodes; no repository code is replaced.
